lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple near-vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance pixels intersecting with horizontally aligned clusters to form a structured grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-to-low vertical luminance gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertically-oriented branchial slits are visible on the anterior-lateral portion of the frame.
